description: Search Hendrik Kleinwächter's open-source book The Sourdough Framework and get the passages that answer a question, each with its chapter, a link and the part of the book it comes from, which read_sourdough_book returns in full. The book covers starters, fermentation, flour, hydration, shaping, baking and troubleshooting. It is written in English, and the search matches English words. Hendrik's published answers to common questions are find_sourdough_answer, and a whole chapter is read_sourdough_book. Without a Loafy account, reading and searching the book and the answers is limited to 3 questions a day, every lookup within 15 minutes counting as one question; with an account it has no limit. The calculators, the guides and the book's table of contents need no account.

limit.description: How many passages to return. Defaults to 3.

query.description: What to look up, in English, e.g. "starter smells like acetone" or "bulk fermentation temperature".

name: search_sourdough_book

input.description: The arguments as the tool used them, after any correction.

license.description: The licence of the book's text: CC BY-SA 4.0, with attribution.

note.description: A remark on the whole result, such as why nothing was found.

notes.description: What was corrected or left out, such as a value outside its range.

passages.description: The passages that answer the question.

part.description: Its number and title, which read_sourdough_book takes.

url.description: The chapter on the book's website.

suggestion.description: Where to look next when nothing fits.

url.description: The same answer, recipe or entry on loafy.ai.

title: Search The Sourdough Framework
